sources.title: Anthropic raises $13B Series F at $183B post-money valuation
Anthropic raises $30 billion in Series G funding at $380 billion post-money valuation

statements.label: Run-rate revenue at the beginning of 2025
statements.quote: At the beginning of 2025, less than two years after launch, Anthropic's run-rate revenue had grown to approximately $1 billion.

statements.label: Run-rate revenue by August 2025
statements.quote: By August 2025, just eight months later, our run-rate revenue reached over $5 billion—making Anthropic one of the fastest-growing technology companies in history.

statements.label: Run-rate revenue
statements.quote: Today, our run-rate revenue is $14 billion, with this figure growing over 10x annually in each of those past three years.
